g.text: Prometheus, Alertmanager and Grafana share one private VIP.
ExternalDNS syncs 3 A records and ownership TXT in Cloudflare.
cert-manager uses DNS-01 and stores 3 ECDSA TLS Secrets.
Envoy loads one certificate per HTTPS listener.
Storage is ephemeral: no StorageClass or persistent volumes in this setup.
Metrics, silences and Grafana database changes can be lost when Pods are replaced.
